family_name: Bradford Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Hightack Tape

spec.description:
Bradford Enviroseal HighTack Tape is a single-sided, aggressive
adhesive sealing tape featuring a flexible synthetic carrier designed to create
durable air and watertight seals on construction membranes. Formulated with a
solvent-free, high-grab adhesive, it adheres aggressively to vapour-permeable
wall wraps, aluminium foil sarking, timber, steel, plastics, and masonry. It is
specifically engineered to seal overlaps, penetrations, window flashings, and
pipe junctions to ensure the integrity of the building envelope.
features: Aggressive high initial tack and long-term permanent adhesion

Flexible
carrier accommodates building movement and thermal expansion

Forms an
airtight and watertight seal around membrane overlaps and penetrations

Safe
formulation: free of solvents, chlorine, and formaldehyde for low emissions

Multisubstrate adhesion: bonds to PE, PP, aluminium foil, timber, plastics, and
metal

Hand tearable or easily cut with a utility blade for quick site
installation

Compatible
with all Bradford Enviroseal and Thermoseal wraps

technical.value: +5°C to +40°C (effective down to -10°C on clean dry surfaces)

spec.fire:
Complies with AS 1530.2 early fire hazard
properties when applied to compliant building membranes
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4200.2, AS 1530.2, Passive House airtight envelope compatible
spec.sustainability:
Solvent-free, zero chlorine, zero formaldehyde, low VOC
emissions
install:
Ensure surfaces to be taped are clean, dry, and free
of dust, grease, oil, and frost

Position membrane overlap with a
minimum 150mm lap (or 50mm if taped per AS 4200.2)

Centre the 60mm HighTack
Tape squarely over the seam or penetration edge

Apply tape smoothly avoiding
tension wrinkles and air bubbles

Press down firmly along the entire tape
length using a plastic squeegee or pressure roller

Seal around pipe and duct
penetrations by cutting overlapping collar strips
selection_checklist:
Verify compatibility with chosen membrane (ideal for Enviroseal RW, CW, and
Tuff)

Calculate total linear metres needed for all horizontal/vertical laps
and penetrations

Ensure surface temperature at time of installation is above
+5°C (or pre-warmed if cold)

Confirm 60mm width is sufficient for joint
width
limitations:
Pressure-sensitive adhesive requires firm
squeegee pressure to activate bond

Must not be applied to wet, greasy, or
dusty substrates

Not intended for permanent outdoor UV exposure exceeding
membrane exposure limits
spec.warranty: Backed by CSR Bradford product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford
Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Hightack Tape (product code 155170) is a premium 60mm
x 25m single-sided adhesive tape featuring an aggressive, solvent-free acrylic
adhesive on a flexible polyolefin carrier. Engineered specifically for sealing
laps and penetrations on Enviroseal vapour-permeable membranes and Thermoseal
sarking, it creates airtight and watertight barriers across diverse construction
substrates including timber, steel, PVC, and foil. Operating reliably from -40°C
to +80°C with zero chlorine or formaldehyde, it is essential for achieving
blower-door airtightness and weather protection in modern energy-efficient
envelopes.
